resources.string: Observation mode allows every call. Active mode can silence or reject unknown numbers. Known contacts and your allowlist always pass. Caller ID can be spoofed. Private/unavailable calls may bypass screening. Rejection does not guarantee voicemail. No audio, internet, or call history is stored.

Unknown callers may be silenced or rejected, including legitimate calls. Contacts permission and the screening role are required; failures allow calls. The selected rule persists until you return to observation mode.
Allowlist: one international +number per line (US 10-digit numbers also accepted)
Not saved: use complete international +numbers or US 10-digit numbers, one per line.
Select this screening app and grant contacts permission first.
Call-screening role unavailable on this device.
An incoming call was checked. No call history saved.
